approach: Horizontal CHS omitted: two finite welded rings with the existing twelve twin-rail radial ties carry roof plan shear. The original 8.5 kN interface/bracing allowance remains an adverse distributed G budget, without favourable mass credit. 96 simultaneous full/partial, signed and biaxial wind patterns each repeated for three gravity/suction states. Ring eccentricities, elevated facade/roof projections and signed opposite vertical couples at actual outer corners included. Lower passive pads release in tension; each adjacent floor strip routes residual to the two captive corners. Ground-floor plinth wind tributary and L-corner spring shears are distributed to three reference shafts with conserved yaw. Fixed roof/plan/soil stiffness, vertical-plane path to corner couple, local floor/arch joints and head/soil capacity remain design questions. Independent component extrema are not one simultaneous house load.
localOptionalBay: Separate unadopted reference in current-house-service-bay.json. Do not add the entire wet sled load to the bay floor. Apply its declared P36/P37 loads only if adopting that control, including moments and hydrostatic action.
